method: A new temporary Git index was populated using read-tree HEAD followed by git add -A and git write-tree. The resulting full tree equals the committed local tree. The remote source index and working files were not rewritten. This binds file contents including newly added files, despite the remote baseline HEAD and dirty flag.
scope: Bindings for the isolated doesvm build, not GitHub Actions evidence or private hardware execution.
publication_note: GitHub Git Data API returned the same complete tree SHA as the local tested source. The published commit has a different envelope/parent history but byte-identical source contents.
